name: Single-sided SPD pedal pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average 279 g for the left/right PD-ES600 SPD pedal pair, from the explicit /pair weight row in the 2025–2026 specification handbook. Single-sided describes the SPD binding on each pedal, not the weight basis: 279 g is the left/right pair total. The handbook notes a supplied 1.0 mm cleat spacer; the weight row does not enumerate cleats or loose accessories.
